## Endpoints

This capability unlocks 10 endpoint(s).

- **`GET /orders`**: List Orders.
  - **supplierReference** (string, in query): Filter by exact supplier order reference.
  - **utcCreatedAtStart** (string, in query): Filter start time (ISO8601) for created-at range. Must be sent with `utcCreatedAtEnd`.
  - **utcCreatedAtEnd** (string, in query): Filter end time (ISO8601) for created-at range. Must be sent with `utcCreatedAtStart`.
  - **utcUpdatedAtStart** (string, in query): Filter start time (ISO8601) for updated-at range. Must be sent with `utcUpdatedAtEnd`.
  - **utcUpdatedAtEnd** (string, in query): Filter end time (ISO8601) for updated-at range. Must be sent with `utcUpdatedAtStart`.
  - **contactEmailAddress** (string, in query): Filter by contact email address.
  - **contactPhoneNumber** (string, in query): Filter by contact phone number (must be a valid phone number).
  - **contactLastName** (string, in query): Filter by partial contact last name (minimum 3 characters).
- **`POST /orders`**: Create Order. Body `OrderCreateRequest`.
- **`DELETE /orders/{orderId}`**: Delete Order. Body `CancelRequest`.
  - **orderId** (string, in path, required): The order ID.
- **`GET /orders/{orderId}`**: Get Order.
  - **orderId** (string, in path, required): The order ID.
- **`PATCH /orders/{orderId}`**: Update Order. Body `OrderUpdateRequest`.
  - **orderId** (string, in path, required): Order ID.
- **`POST /orders/{orderId}/cancel`**: Order Cancellation (POST). Body `CancelRequest`.
  - **orderId** (string, in path, required): The order ID.
- **`POST /orders/{orderId}/confirm`**: Confirm Order With identityId. Body `OrderUpdateRequest`.
  - **orderId** (string, in path, required): Order ID.
- **`POST /orders/{orderId}/extend`**: Order Extend. Body `OrderUpdateRequest`.
  - **orderId** (string, in path, required): The order ID.
- **`POST /orders/{orderId}/notify`**: Notify Order. Body `NotifyRequest`.
  - **orderId** (string, in path, required): The order ID.
- **`PATCH /orders/{orderId}/preview`**: Preview Order Update With identityId. Body `OrderUpdateRequest`.
  - **orderId** (string, in path, required): Order ID.

## Integration notes

Behaviour the specification does not carry, from [docs.ventrata.com/capabilities/cart](https://docs.ventrata.com/capabilities/cart).

### Routes this capability extends

- `POST /gifts`
- `POST /orders/{orderId}/cancel`
- `GET /orders`
- `POST /orders/{orderId}/notify`

### Rules and conditionals

- When using this capability, if you omit `orderId` from the initial request, Ventrata creates a new order automatically and returns `orderId` in the response.
- If you're using the cart capability and want to set a `resellerReference` you should do so as a booking update as there are no reseller references on the order level.
- Order invoice and voucher delivery URLs are returned directly on serialized order/booking objects. ## Schema Additions (JSON) These are additive fragments showing only fields introduced by this capability. ### `Booking` ### `BookingWriteRequest` ### `Error` ### `Gift` ### `GiftCreateRequest`
